borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Construction of a front porch to 135 Woodbridge Road and the construction of a new two storey 3x bedroom semi-detached dwelling with a front porch, single storey rear extension, rear dormer, and cycle store
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

<p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">Any upper-floor window located in a wall or roof slope forming a side elevation of the dwellinghouse must be obscure-glazed, and non-opening unless the parts of the window which can be opened are more than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which the window is installed.&nbsp;</span></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development falling within CLASS A and E in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the Local Planning Authority.<br></p>
<p>The development shall remain in C3 (single dwellinghouse) use only.</p><p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>The development must be in accordance with Construction Environmental
Management Plan (CEMP) as approved. The Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period for the development.&nbsp;</p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:115%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior to commencement of the development, a CLP Pro Forma
must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council. The details shall
include the numbers, size and routes of construction vehicles, provisions
within/around the site to ensure that all vehicles associated with the
construction works are properly managed to prevent any unwanted disruption to
other highway users, and other matters relating to traffic management to be
agreed with the licencing officers of the council. Approved details shall be
implemented throughout the project period and any changes to the document must
be reported back to the council’s planning and highways department.&nbsp;&nbsp;<b><o:p></o:p></b></span></p>

<p><span data-teams="true">The development shall be implemented in accordance with the car parking details approved, including the&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">installation of&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">adequate hardstanding,&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">prior to occupation.</span></p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Existing Sections and Site Location and Proposed Block Plan - drawing no. 2025/07/135WR Sheet 02 of 06 - dated 07/25</li><li>Proposed Elevations, Ground Floor and First Floor Plans - drawing no. 2025/07/135WR Sheet 03 of 06 - dated 07/25</li><li>Proposed Second Floor and Roof Plans - drawing no. 2025/07/135WR Sheet 04 of 06 - dated 07/25</li><li>Proposed Sections and Bin Stores - drawing no. 2025/07/135WR Sheet 05 of 06 - dated 07/25</li><li>Parking Plan - drawing no. 2025/07/135WR Sheet 06 of 06 - dated 07/25<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></span></p></li><li>Planning and Design and Access Statement</li><li>Construction Environmental Plan&nbsp;</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
